title: 第13章 妖丁争锋险被拍死第14章 面见妖王各有造化
content_zh:
妖群中爆发出一阵骚动，一众妖怪穿过群妖，来到了最前面。
莫凡下意识地看了过去，却见为首的是一位身穿黑袍，皮肤黝黑的干瘦老者。
“这是……人？”
看到这老者的刹那，莫凡却是被惊得不轻，因为对方和周围这些个妖怪完全是格格不入，全身上下几乎没有一点妖怪的样子，活脱脱的就是一个人类！
“不对……这是一只妖怪！”
很快，莫凡便心中凛然，发现了一些端倪。
因为他突然发现这干瘦老者的袖袍之中居然不止两只手，而是有足足四只手！
干瘦老者虽为人形，可与莫凡一般头上无毛，光头上还显得有几分黝黑，看起来十分的怪异。
这老者一出现，周围妖怪们的议论声顿时小了不少，明显对这老者有些许敬畏。
莫凡发现在这老者的身后跟着三个妖怪，这些妖怪与狼妖青面等人差不多，皆是化出了些许人类形体的妖。
仅从表面上来看，莫凡能够猜出的也就只有一只蜘蛛妖。
至于另外两个家伙，莫凡却是猜不出它们的本体，不过却是发现这两个家伙和那干瘦老者一般，都是光头，倒是有几分特别。
见到这老者似乎在群妖里有些威望，莫凡当即便向其呼救起来，“妖兄，救命啊！我们只是来投奔黑风山妖王的，并非无礼小妖！！”
“大胆！”
莫凡话语刚一出口，黑袍老者身后的蜘蛛妖便顿时冲他呵斥起来。
“呔！你个丑八怪好不懂礼数，还未完全化出灵身也敢与俺家老爷称兄道弟？！”
蜘蛛妖的呵斥却是令莫凡心中有些纳闷，心道那是你家老爷又不是我家老爷，我怎么就不懂礼数了？
还有这些妖怪怎么就这么讨厌，张口闭口丑八怪。
你全家才是丑八怪！
虽然莫凡知道自己的本体是有点丑，但特么吃你家大米了还是咋的？

当然，此时的他还不敢将这些心里话给说出来。
“癞蛤蟆化的妖？”
那黑袍老人目光在被捆绑的两妖一虎身上略一打量，便将视线重新放在了莫凡的身上。
莫凡见终于吸引了黑袍老人的注意，当即客气道：“启禀妖丁老爷，俺的本体正是一只癞蛤蟆！”
从刚才这些妖怪的话语中他明白这黑袍老人是什么妖丁，似乎地位要高于青面这些普通小妖的，因此倒也顺着这个称呼开口。
“嗯，难怪这么丑。”
黑袍妖丁点点头，口中说出的话却是令莫凡脸皮直抽抽。
特么长得丑也有错吗？
至于每个妖怪都来上那么一句？
“青面，这是怎么一回事？”黑袍妖丁看向一旁的狼妖青面。
早在这黑袍妖丁出现的时候，青面等人就被这些妖怪给拦住了去路。
青面眉头微蹙，虽然不喜这些家伙的作风，不过还是将之前的说辞给复述了一遍。
“野妖？”
黑袍妖丁目光一闪，旋即冷哼道：“按照俺们黑风山大王爷爷定下的规矩，凡黑风山地界内自然诞生的妖怪都不能算做野妖，你等可有问清楚这他们的来历了？”
“这……”
青面听闻这话顿时被问得一愣，不知道该如何接口。
“按大王爷爷定下的规矩，若不是野妖，便不能随意打杀，需尽量招揽入黑风山，最不济也要交由他老人家发落才是。
青面你们这些家伙好大的胆子！
还是说你们家的独眼老爷敢私下里抓我黑风山领地小妖开席面了？”黑袍妖丁的一番话说得青面额头冷汗直冒，嘴里连说“不敢”。
content_en:
A commotion broke out among the monsters, and a group of monsters passed through the group of monsters and came to the front.
Mo Fan subconsciously looked over and saw that the leader was a skinny old man wearing a black robe and dark skin.
"Is this... a person?"
The moment he saw the old man, Mo Fan was shocked, because he was completely incompatible with the monsters around him. There was almost no monster in his body, he was just a human!
"No...this is a monster!"
Soon, Mo Fan felt awe-struck and discovered some clues.
Because he suddenly discovered that there were not only two hands in the sleeves of this skinny old man, but four hands!
Although the skinny old man is in human form, he has no hair on his head like Mo Fan, and his bald head is somewhat dark, which makes him look very weird.
As soon as the old man appeared, the chatter among the surrounding monsters suddenly became quieter, and they were obviously in awe of the old man.
Mo Fan discovered that there were three monsters following the old man. These monsters were similar to the wolf demon Qingmian and others. They were all monsters that had transformed into some human form.
From the superficial appearance alone, Mo Fan could only guess that there was a spider demon.
As for the other two guys, Mo Fan couldn't guess their identities, but he found that these two guys were bald like the skinny old man, which was a bit special.
Seeing that the old man seemed to have some prestige among the demons, Mo Fandang immediately called out to him for help, "Brother Demon, help! We are just here to seek refuge with the Demon King of Black Wind Mountain, we are not rude little demons!!"
"Be bold!"
As soon as Mo Fan spoke, the spider demon behind the black-robed old man immediately yelled at him.
"Hey! You're an ugly monster who doesn't understand etiquette. How dare you call me brother-in-law before you've fully transformed into a spiritual body?!"
The spider demon's scolding made Mo Fan feel a little confused. He thought that was your master, not mine. Why don't I understand etiquette?
And why are these monsters so annoying? They are so ugly when they open their mouths and shut them up.
Your whole family is the ugly one!
Although Mo Fan knows that his body is a bit ugly, why did he eat your rice?
Of course, at this time, he did not dare to speak out these inner thoughts.
"A demon transformed into a toad?"
The old man in black robe briefly looked at the two tied demons and one tiger, and then focused his attention on Mo Fan again.
Seeing that he finally attracted the attention of the old man in black robe, Mo Fan immediately said politely: "Master Demon Ding, my true body is exactly a toad!"
From the words of these monsters, he understood what kind of monster this old man in black robe was. He seemed to have a higher status than ordinary little monsters like Qingmian, so he followed this title.
"Well, no wonder it's so ugly."
The black-robed demon nodded, but the words he said made Mo Fan's face twitch.
Is there anything wrong with being ugly?
As for every monster saying this?
"Qingmian, what's going on?" Black-robed demon Ding looked at the wolf demon Qingmian beside him.
As early as when the black-robed monster appeared, Qingmian and the others were blocked by these monsters.
Qingmian frowned slightly. Although he didn't like the style of these guys, he still repeated his previous remarks.
"Wild monster?"
The black-robed demon's eyes flashed, and he snorted coldly: "According to the rules set by our Black Wind Mountain King, all monsters naturally born in the Black Wind Mountain cannot be counted as wild monsters. Have you asked clearly about their origins?"
"This..."
Qingmian was stunned when he heard this and didn't know how to respond.
"According to the rules set by Grandpa Wang, if they are not wild monsters, they cannot be killed at will. They must be recruited into Black Wind Mountain as much as possible, and at the worst, they must be handed over to his old man.
Qingmian, you guys are so brave!
Or are you saying that your one-eyed master dares to catch me, the little demon from the Black Wind Mountain Territory, to have a banquet in private? "One of the black-robed demon dingHis words caused cold sweat to break out on Qing Mian's forehead, and he kept saying "dare not".
